title: NANO Nuclear to Hold Second Quarter Business Update Webcast on May 14, 2026
body_markdown:
**New York, N.Y., May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. (NASDAQ: NNE) (“NANO Nuclear” or “the Company”)** , a leading advanced nuclear micro modular reactor and technology company focused on developing clean energy solutions, today announced it will host its second quarter fiscal 2026 business update webcast on **Thursday, May 14, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET.** The webcast will follow the anticipated filing of the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for its second fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2026.


Additional details will be available in the Investor Relations section of NANO Nuclear’s website at[https://ir.nanonuclearenergy.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=T9aTSZBb0g6VvQV0AvM4PNR6u9gpLNTuxv1vs7M3UNFixuB6YJsKVONTc0AvWaA3Zsav5CtDboXy_btcD7CPfYQjvanwSR3Mgaxo9Vw7QnAvtw41EKnTmufaxMHrUvsu) .


**Event:** NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. Q2 FY 2026 Business Update Webcast


**Date:** Thursday, May 14, 2026


**Time:** 5:00 p.m. ET


**Live Call:** 1-877-269-7756 (U.S. Toll Free) or 1-201-689-7817 (International)


**Webcast:**[https://ir.nanonuclearenergy.com/news-events/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yhrugDq6Es__RVNOLzuTfxwB7_cqFZnJE1VCe_GBWZyrXy0TIHjfqDJ6pQ3NdVLprZhAt8GGOOsZGUL8azrdy6h8fM8VadEre5l0hS0iK6ciQH7Ic691kW0kmq89brlm8ymRtuxrZw__q-dy3fzSrwZAF749TDFMG7w9VrUAh-U=)


A replay of the webcast will be made available on NANO Nuclear’s website beginning shortly after the call that evening.
